The test image shows a corn leaf with:
- Prominent white/silvery streaking running parallel to leaf veins
- Alternating green and bleached/white interveinal stripes
- Small scattered brown/reddish dots on the leaf surface
- Overall heavily bleached appearance

Top candidates: Maize_streak_virus (streaky white pattern), Downy_mildew (whitish systemic symptoms), Common_rust (brown pustules). Let me view reference images.

The Common_rust reference (bottom-right panel) shows a leaf with similar whitish bleaching and scattered pustules. The Maize_streak_virus reference shows characteristic white/yellow parallel streaks. Let me check Southern_rust and Physoderma_brown_spot as well.
The Physoderma_brown_spot reference shows white streaking with brown spots. The Maize_dwarf_mosaic_virus shows broader chlorotic bands. Let me check one more candidate.

**Analysis Summary:**

The test image shows a corn leaf with:
- Predominantly white/silvery bleached appearance covering most of the leaf
- Narrow green stripes remaining (along veins)
- Small uniformly scattered brown dots throughout

**Comparing with references:**
- **Common_rust** (bottom-right panel): Leaf with extensive pale/bleached tissue and many small scattered brown rust pustules — very strong visual match
- **Maize_streak_virus**: Shows narrower, finer yellow/white streaks on still-green leaf — stripes are narrower/finer than what's in the test image
- **Maize_dwarf_mosaic_virus**: Broader chlorotic patches but no scattered brown dots
- **Physoderma_brown_spot**: Brown spots tend to cluster near midrib bands, not uniformly scattered
- **Southern_rust / Goss_wilt**: Not matching the extensive silvery bleaching pattern

The test image most closely matches **Common_rust** at an advanced/senescent stage: the leaf tissue has become necrotic and bleached (giving the silvery-white appearance), while dried/old rust pustules remain as the scattered small brown dots. This pattern was clearly visible in the bottom-right panel of the Common_rust reference collage.

The bottom-right panel of the Common_rust reference shows an almost identical pattern of a predominantly pale/white leaf with scattered brown rust pustules. The interveinal bleaching with green vein stripes remaining is consistent with severe common rust at a late stage."}
